hypothesis: A small independent central field or longitudinal channel improves worst-time normalized detailed balance without reducing coverage in a multichannel seed.
alternative: Apparent improvements depend on readout time or trade balance for coverage; no tested perturbation uniformly improves the size/time comparison.
prediction: A retained direction must weakly improve both worst-time balance and worst-time moment error, and not reduce minimum coverage, at every tested size; at least one balance improvement must be strict. This is a reduced diagnostic only, not phase promotion.
scope: Reduced full-Hamiltonian QZ sensitivity; no asymptotic extrapolation or time averaging
perturbation_scale: 0.05 * max(abs(gx),abs(gy)) in unscaled positive-coefficient energy units
